label: late copy-phase steps (absolute step t >= 13)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.5% of mass); essentially silent during original input and at <DEL>. Firing depends on absolute time step: rate is about 0 for t<=10, 12% at t=12, 38% at t=13, and 50-65% at t=14-17, so it shows up mainly in long sequences (L=8-9) when the later original tokens (recall_idx >= 5) are being output. Within a sequence, activation often climbs over successive copy steps. Even at late steps only about half of positions fire. Output identity modulates the rate (out_tok w/o/q/a about 30% vs about 15% for others) and more digits in the sequence raises it slightly, but neither gives a clean rule. The predicate (phase==2)&(t>=13) gets about 0.88 of activation mass on dev but only about 0.52 precision.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: o, w, q, a, c, z; least: s, r, i, h) and the current input token, by step (t=5: i, j, y, s; t=4: i, s, y, j; t=6: i, y, j, s); timing cues that raise it most: L=4 & t=7, recall_idx=7, t=14.
